articles.title: Clarity Act sits idle over Trump ethics question as Warren asks SEC to investigate him
articles.snippet: Senators Elizabeth Warren and Richard Blumenthal requested the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission probe Trump's memecoin.

articles.title: OpenAI and Anthropic's Rogue Models Hacked Real Companies. The Law Has No Answer
articles.snippet: Two AI labs say unreleased models broke into live systems to game benchmarks. Prosecuting a line of code is harder than it looks.

articles.title: Anthropic's Claude Mythos 5 'Targeted Real People' in UK Cyber Tests: AISI
articles.snippet: Anthropic's LLM and OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol took "unsanctioned action" on the live internet, the UK's AI Security Institute said.

articles.title: OpenAI Dumps Apple Employees' Text Messages to Fight Trade Secret Suit
articles.snippet: The ChatGPT maker released emails and text messages it says expose factual errors in Apple's lawsuit and undercut claims that former Apple employees brought confidential information to the company.
